instructions: One native bitmap per call. Six initial views, six geometric/floor refinements, one additional workshop floor repair. All historical V75 bytes and generated candidates preserved. No pixel transformation, crop, CSS rotation or mirror.
acceptance: Ground segments, useful aperture feet, minimum vertical jamb heights, opaque cavity and native floor alpha edge measured after visual inspection. Requested yaw +/-25deg; actual measured yaw takes precedence.

refinement.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image is the edit target, the SAME native building identity. Correct only its geometric ground support and entrance. Keep every original material, roof detail, amber/cyan light, empty alcove, and functional identity. Keep transparent alpha outside; doorway interior must remain fully opaque dark painted stone.
This must be a rigid LEFT-side-visible building on level ground viewed by the unchanged ORTHOGRAPHIC camera with pitch/elevation35° and yaw0°. Increase the building's true ground yaw to -25°; do NOT tilt the camera or image, do NOT skew/mirror. All vertical inner door jambs remain upright. Front foundation edge must be a visibly straight diagonal slope of −0.267 (falls DOWN toward the LEFT) in screen pixels. Its actual corner supports should be approximately front LEFT at17% of image width/93% of image height, front RIGHT at97% width/60% height on a landscape3:2 canvas. This is deliberately stronger than the shallow front slope of the edit target; the visible exterior side wall needs consistent depth. Draw roof and side-wall planes coherently for this changed orientation.
CRITICAL entrance correction: remove the horizontal VERTICAL FACE of the raised stone strip currently crossing the bottom of the door. No raised entrance plinth, no step, no stair, no lip, no block across the opening. The doorway floor ends in a sharp zero-height edge flush with the flat ground; from inner cavity floor to outside ground is level. The two inner jamb feet land on that same diagonal floor edge, continuous with the front wall contact plane. Side wall base stones may remain, but the opening between jambs is unobstructed and not raised.
Door: very generous useful width between inner jamb feet, at least25% of the full front edge span; minimum usable upright height450pixels in a1536×1024 output. There must be no opaque door leaf, silhouette or external prop obstructing it, just dark recessed floor and walls with alpha255. Keep whole single building centered, full roof tips and side walls visible, a little true transparent margin. No text, characters, furniture, ground patch, horizon or shadow outside the building. Produce ONE corrected raster cutout, not a diagram or multiple views.

additionalFloorRepair.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the supplied angled industrial Yautja workshop sprite. Preserve the ENTIRE building, three-quarter LEFT view, roof planes, ventilator stacks, basalt/bronze materials, lighting, open tool bays and silhouette EXACTLY. Change ONLY the central walk-through doorway bottom floor. The entrance still has a thick VERTICAL stone step/riser spanning between the inner jamb feet; remove that raised riser completely. Lower the entire doorway floor to the ground contact level of the surrounding wall base blocks and extend the two inner jamb feet to that same level. The floor must meet transparency at a single thin zero-height diagonal edge with no vertical band or face underneath: a truly STEP-FREE walk-through entrance. Side masonry support blocks and raised tool-bay floors can remain unchanged; only the central opening must be flush and accessible. Paint the opening with an opaque dark cavity and floor texture, alpha255. Never make the doorway a transparent hole. Do not enlarge a ramp/platform out of the building. Keep the opening very tall and wide. Do not change camera, ground yaw, facade geometry, materials or other details. Transparent alpha outside the building preserved. ONE landscape building sprite only, no writing, diagrams, people, props, shadows or background.
